title: Project files
subtitle: Agents, suites, experiments and policies of this project. Every save is checked and versioned.

sync.title: Sync with your machine
sync.body: Keep a local copy of this project in step with the server. Set HEIMDALL_TOKEN to an API token, then run:
sync.rules: pull never overwrites a file you changed since the last sync and push never overwrites a file changed here; both list conflicts and stop. Add -force to overwrite. Files up to 64 MiB sync; files over 1 MiB are not versioned.
sync.tokenLink: Create an API token (Settings, API tokens)
sync.localToken: On a local server the token is its write token (BENCH_WRITE_TOKEN); pull works without one.

empty: This folder is empty. Create a file to get started.
badName: Use a relative name without ".." or a leading slash.
readOnly: You can read these files. Ask an org admin for the member role to edit them.

editor.newFile: New file: it is created when you save.
editor.binary: This file is binary and cannot be edited here.
editor.conflict: The file changed since you opened it. Reload to get the latest version, then apply your edit again.
